note: Section 9 of the build spec. Cases 1-9 carry an expected ruling. H1-H3 are held out: written before the first run, with no expected answer, run once, and published exactly as they come out. Nothing here may be edited after a run to make a result match.

rules.text: No insults or harassment of other members.
No scam or phishing links. Any offence is a ban.
No spam: no flooding a channel with repeated messages.
No impersonating the team or moderators.
